items.claim: Ian Garry being the tallest opponent Islam has faced is not a significant factor in the matchup.
items.quote: the tallest opponent for Islam he's faced is also a huge factor. I don't think it is a huge factor, honestly.

items.claim: Kamaru Usman's best days are behind him following his loss in the Dricus Du Plessis fight.
items.quote: It was pretty obvious in the DDP fight that Usman's best days are behind him.

items.claim: Ian Garry against Islam will be a more competitive fight than Kamaru Usman against Islam.
items.quote: Ian against Islam is going to be a more competitive fight than Kamaru Usman and Islam.

items.claim: The late stoppage in the Bobby Green fight negatively affected Jalin Turner.
items.quote: I believe the late stoppage in the Bobby Green fight also affected Jalin Turner.

items.claim: Beneil Dariush should not be considered a good win at this point because he is close to retirement.
items.quote: I wouldn't consider Daria a good win at this point cuz he's close to retirement.
